Name: Biscuit the Puppy- NPC
Author: Otterlyadorable
Description:
[center]
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/ROlxj43cYpo4f5IKvR/giphy.gif[/img]﻿
......................................................................................................[/center]
[center]Biscuit is an adorable little NPC that moves into the valley all the way from Zuzu City! Watch as she goes around town getting into mischief or playing with her best friends Vincent or Dusty! Find use for the trash you find around town by gifting this pup her favorite treasure! you may get something good out of it! and depending on who you are friends with or are dating you will get random surprises from her as you gain her trust! [/center][center][/center][center]﻿﻿﻿......................................................................................................
Instructions
......................................................................................................
install SMAPI and Contents Patcher 
extract this zip into your "Mods" folder
When you exit your farm towards the bus stop it will trigger her first event
enjoy! (note you must have seen the first wizard event first)
**DO NOT PANIC IF YOU DON'T SEE HER IN TOWN RIGHT AWAY!**
she usually shows up on the second day of her arrival.

Heart Event locations +
......................................................................................................
There are actually more events than this. This is just a simple list of when the basic heart events will trigger. In total, there are 22 "cutscene" events in the mod and 39 "Gift" events (events where Biscuit brings you a present at random.) These are all triggered by different variables such as: who your friends are, who you are dating, and how good a friend you are to Biscuit. 

[spoiler]
0 heart- [spoiler]Meeting Biscuit. Just leave your farm and go to the bus stop after installing[/spoiler]
2 heart- [spoiler]will trigger when you walk into town at 2 hearts[/spoiler]
4 heart- [spoiler]Triggers when you enter 1 willow lane at 4 hearts[/spoiler]
6 heart- [spoiler]Triggers when you walk into the Mullner's home at 6 hearts[/spoiler]
8 heart- [spoiler]Triggers at 8 hearts at the beach[/spoiler]
10 heart- [spoiler]Triggers when you head up to the railroad  at 10 hearts but it has to be raining[/spoiler]
12 heart- [spoiler]Triggers when you enter the town at 12 hearts between 8 to 11 PM[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]

.....................................................................................................
[spoiler]
 Q: [b]Can I share photos/videos/feedback or a review?[/b]
A: Please feel free to share any photos or videos of the mod! I would love feedback on whether you're enjoying/ not enjoying the mod!

Q: [b]I noticed an error in Spelling/programming etc. would it be okay to mention it?[/b]
A: Don't be shy to mention errors in the comments. I won't be upset over a mistake I made and would like to fix it.

Q: [b]Can you translate this mod? Can I?[/b]
A: The only language I know is English. I know some barely passible Canadian French and ASL but I would not be able to translate this mod sadly. If you are experienced with translating mods and would like to try you can [u]message me in private[/u] and we can discuss. Please do not translate without permission though. Also, be aware the mod is very pun-heavy and that may not transfer over too well.

Q: [b]I'm making an NPC Mod myself. Can I use assets or Mention Biscuit it my own NPC mod?[/b]
A: Please message me about this privately and we can discuss it. I probably wouldn't mind but I would  need to check over some things

Q: [b]is this mod compatible with SDVE other mods of that ilk?[/b]
A: I have no idea when it comes to total compatibility but if the mod doesn't change the map too much it should be fine.
any currently reported issues with SDVE and Ridgeside have been fixed so everything should be fine! if you encounter any issues let me know and I will try my best to fix it.
UPDATE: I keep getting mixed comments about SDVE and the map locations being wrong since the new update. I will have to wait until I have the full picture of whats going on before I can fix whatever needs fixing. Unfortunately, I do not have the time to test SDVE with Biscuit atm so I can't do much without more details.
